details.description: Glucon-D is the preferred choice in summer when the scorching heat drains out body glucose. Glucon-D contains 99.4% glucose. It is easily absorbed by the body, thus giving instant energy and rejuvenation.

Glucon-D Instant Energy Nutrition Drink contains 99. 4% of the glucose that helps replenish body glucose and fills you with the energy required to stay active. It comes in a variety of flavours like nimbu, tangy orange and regular. It is easily absorbed by the body, thus giving out an instant energy boost and refreshment. Enriched with Vitamin-D and Minerals, including Calcium and Phosphorus, this glucose drink helps you charge up to fight tiredness and supports immunity. Add Glucon-D to a glass of water every day to provide growing active children with the energy that keeps them going and acts as a refreshment after a long day.
details.usageInstructions:
Add three tablespoons of powder in 200ml water.
Stir well and drink.

details.description: Unlock instant energy and refreshment with Glucon-D, the versatile glucose drink that's packed with essential vitamins, minerals, and the power of 99.4% pure glucose. Designed to quickly replenish your body's glucose levels, this delightful drink comes in a variety of flavours like tangy orange, refreshing nimbu, and the classic regular, ensuring there's a taste to suit every palate. Enriched with Vitamin D and minerals like calcium and phosphorus, Glucon-D not only provides an energy boost but also supports your immunity and bone health. Whether you're an active adult or a growing child, this glucose-rich beverage is the perfect companion to help you power through the day, whether it's tackling the summer heat or conquering your daily tasks. With its easy absorption and refreshing properties, Glucon-D is the ideal solution to fight fatigue and keep you charged, energised, and ready to take on the world.

details.description:
Glucon-D Activon Electrolyte Energy Drink is here to supercharge your day! Life moves fast, and we’re all constantly on the go—whether it’s work, exercise, or just keeping up with the hustle and bustle of daily activities. But we all know the feeling: the heat, the sweat, and the exhaustion that hits when you push yourself too hard. That’s when you need a pick-me-up that truly works, not just any ordinary ‘thanda’ drink.
Enter Glucon-D Activon—the ultimate solution to restore what you’ve lost. Packed with powerful electrolytes and glucose, this drink instantly recharges you, giving you the boost you need to keep moving, stay focused, and crush whatever’s next on your to-do list. Whether you're sweating it out during a workout, traveling, or simply feeling worn out, Glucon-D Activon is your go-to energy partner.
But that’s not all—it’s delicious too, bursting with a refreshing apple flavor! And with the added vitamins and glucose, you’ll feel that energy surge, helping you stay active, sharp, and ready to take on anything the day throws at you.
No mixing, no hassle—just pop in the straw and enjoy a swift, delicious boost. Perfect for whenever you’re feeling drained or need that extra jolt to keep your momentum going!
Shake it up before you drink, enjoy it straight away after opening, and store it away from direct sunlight to keep it fresh. With Glucon-D Activon, you’re not just staying energized—you’re staying charged.
